name: Outreach
description_en:
Outreach’s current site spans prospecting, account planning, meeting intelligence, deal management and forecasting. Agent Studio configures workflows, Knowledge supplies company material for personalization, and Omni supports questions and actions in several surfaces. This is broader than an email sequencer; a buyer should select the needed motion instead of assuming every revenue function is included. The old outreach.io entry redirects to outreach.ai.

A proposed pilot is to upload a small approved knowledge set, configure one account-research or follow-up workflow and review its proposed action against the source CRM record. Define what the agent may do and who handles exceptions before connecting more systems. The public site describes configurable controls and audit trails, but this research did not test permissions, approval enforcement, retry logic or forecasting quality.
description_zh:
Outreach 当前官网覆盖找客户、账户规划、会议智能、交易管理与预测。Agent Studio 配置流程，Knowledge 为个性化提供公司资料，Omni 在多个界面支持问答和动作。范围比邮件序列更广，应按所需业务流程选择，不能假定所有营收功能都包含在内。旧 outreach.io 入口跳转至 outreach.ai。

建议试点先上传少量经批准资料，配置一个账户研究或跟进流程，再对照 CRM 源记录审查建议动作。增加连接系统前，应定义智能体可做什么以及异常负责人。公开官网描述可配置控制与审计轨迹，但本次未测试权限、批准执行、重试逻辑或预测质量。

items.en: Essentials focuses on conversation intelligence and coaching; Core emphasizes pipeline creation and includes multichannel sequencing. Plus combines and expands these areas, while Pro adds forecasting and managed services. A team needing only a fixed email follow-up should assess whether this breadth is justified. The site describes an online platform with enterprise controls; source licensing and self-hosting were not established. Confirm credit rates, API limits and required integrations in the exact offer before rollout.
items.zh: Essentials 聚焦会话智能与辅导；Core 侧重商机创建并包含多渠道序列。Plus 组合并扩展这些领域，Pro 增加预测及托管服务。只需固定邮件跟进的团队应判断是否需要这一广度。官网描述带企业控制的在线平台，未确认源代码许可或自托管。上线前应按确切报价核对额度费率、API 限额和所需集成。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The current pricing page explicitly combines user licenses with consumption-based AI credits. Essentials lists 10,000 credits, Core 25,000, Plus 50,000 and Pro 100,000; the retrieved page does not make the credit replenishment interval or payable amount sufficiently clear for a total-cost calculation. Specific AI actions consume defined credits and additional packs can be bought. Implementation services, connectors, extra instances and listener licenses may be additional. No continuing free plan or general trial entitlement was confirmed.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前定价页明确组合用户许可与按消耗计的 AI 额度。Essentials 列 10,000 额度、Core 25,000、Plus 50,000、Pro 100,000；本次页面未充分明确补充周期或应付金额，无法可靠计算总成本。具体 AI 动作消耗规定额度，也可购买额外额度包。实施服务、连接器、额外实例与监听许可可能另计。尚未确认长期免费套餐或通用试用权益。
